q1.explanationZh: suit“适合”加 -able 构成形容词 suitable“适合的”，be suitable for“适合……”。

q3.explanationZh: sum 名词“总数；金额”，a sum of money“一笔钱”；也可作动词“总结”。

q4.explanationZh: sum 的相关词 summarise“概括”，英式拼写 -ise，美式拼写 -ize，两种都对。

q5.explanationZh: summary 名词“摘要”，注意双写 m，a brief summary“简短的概要”。

q6.explanationZh: summer 名词“夏季”，注意双写 m，this summer“今年夏天”。

q7.explanationZh: sun 名词“太阳；阳光”，in the sun“在阳光下”。

q8.explanationZh: sun“太阳”+ bathe“沐浴”= sunbathe“晒日光浴”，词尾有 e。

q9.explanationZh: sun + light“光”= sunlight“阳光”，不可数名词。

q10.explanationZh: sun 双写 n 再加 -y，构成形容词 sunny“晴朗的”。

q11.explanationZh: sun + rise“升起”= sunrise“日出”，at sunrise“在日出时”。

q13.explanationZh: super 形容词“极好的”，a super meal“极好的饭菜”。

q14.explanationZh: superb 形容词“极佳的”，比 super 多一个 b，in superb form“状态极佳”。

q15.explanationZh: superior 形容词“较好的；上级的”，也可作名词“上级”，be superior to“比……优越”。

q16.explanationZh: super“超级”+ market“市场”= supermarket“超市”。

q17.explanationZh: super“在上面”+ vise“看”，supervise“监督；管理”。

q18.explanationZh: supervise 去 e 加 -or 表示人，supervisor“监督人；导师”。

q19.explanationZh: supper 名词“晚饭”，注意双写 p，for supper“晚饭吃”；不要和 super 混淆。

q20.explanationZh: supply 作名词“供应”，作动词“供给”，第三人称单数 supplies。

q21.explanationZh: support 作动词“支持；供养”，作名词“支持”，support one’s family“养家”。

q22.explanationZh: suppose 及物动词“假定；猜想”，be supposed to do“应该做”。

q23.explanationZh: sure 形容词“确信的”，也可作副词“当然”，make sure“确保”。

q24.explanationZh: surf 动词“上网浏览；冲浪”，surf the Internet“上网”。

q25.explanationZh: sur“在上面”+ face“面”= surface“表面”。

q26.explanationZh: surgeon“外科医生”，注意 -geon 的拼写。

q27.explanationZh: surgery“外科手术”，与 surgeon“外科医生”同根。

q28.explanationZh: sur + name“名字”= surname“姓”，也叫 family name。

q29.explanationZh: surprise 作动词“使惊奇”，作名词“惊奇”，to one’s surprise“使某人吃惊的是”。

q30.explanationZh: surround 及物动词“包围”，注意双写 r。

q31.explanationZh: surround 加 -ing 构成 surrounding，作形容词“周围的”，复数 surroundings 作名词“环境”。

q32.explanationZh: survey 动词“调查；测勘”，作名词“调查”时重音在前。

q33.explanationZh: survive“幸存；从……中活下来”，名词 survival，“幸存者”是 survivor。

q34.explanationZh: sum 作名词“金额”，a sum of money“一笔钱”，“一大笔”用 large 修饰。

q35.explanationZh: superior 本身含比较意义，后面用 to 而不用 than：be superior to“比……优越”。

accept: supply sb. with sth./supply sth. to sb.

q36.explanationZh: supply sb. with sth. = supply sth. to sb.“向某人提供某物”，注意两种结构的介词不同。

q37.explanationZh: in support of“支持；拥护”，support 在这里是名词。

accept: be supposed to do sth./should do/ought to do sth.

q38.explanationZh: be supposed to do sth.“应该做某事”，相当于 should do / ought to do sth.。

q39.explanationZh: suppose sb. to be ...“猜想某人是……”，to be 后接表语。

q40.explanationZh: be sure of“确信”，of 后接名词、代词或动名词。

q41.explanationZh: 后面接从句时用 be sure that ...“确信……”。

q42.explanationZh: make sure“查明；确保”，后面常接 that 从句或 of。

accept: be sure to do sth./be certain to do sth.

q43.explanationZh: be sure to do sth. = be certain to do sth.“一定会做某事”，to 后接动词原形。

q44.explanationZh: surf 动词“浏览”，surf the Internet“上网”，Internet 前用 the。

q45.explanationZh: heart“心脏”修饰 surgeon“外科医生”，前面加 a。

accept: a hotel set in peaceful surroundings

q46.explanationZh: “环境”用复数 surroundings；set in 是过去分词短语，修饰 hotel。

q47.explanationZh: to one’s surprise“使某人吃惊的是”，surprise 作名词，常放在句首。

q48.explanationZh: sum 作动词“计算……的总数”，sum to“总计达”。

q49.explanationZh: to 后接动词原形；学技能是为了在意外中“生存”，填 survive。

q50.explanationZh: Smith 是英国常见的“姓”，填 surname。

q51.explanationZh: wouldn’t 后接动词原形，It wouldn’t surprise me“我不会感到惊讶”。

q52.explanationZh: from sunup to sunset“从日出到日落”，sunset 与 sunup 相对。

q53.explanationZh: 主语 Our food 是第三人称单数，一般现在时，supply 变 y 为 i 加 -es：supplies。

q55.explanationZh: to 后接动词原形，survey the land“测勘土地”。

q56.explanationZh: can be 后接过去分词构成被动语态，summarise 的过去分词是 summarised（美式 summarized）。

q57.explanationZh: a sum of money“一笔钱”，填 sum。

q58.explanationZh: to 后接动词原形，与 restrict 并列，supervise“监督”。

q59.sampleAnswer: My grandma’s eyesight is too poor to read small words, so she needs a mobile phone suitable for the elderly people.
references: My grandma’s eyesight is too poor to read small words, so she needs a mobile phone suitable for the elderly people.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “眼力不济，看不了”用 too ... to ...；suitable for ... 作后置定语修饰 a mobile phone。

q60.sampleAnswer: About three-fourths of the earth’s surface is covered by water.
references: About three-fourths of the earth’s surface is covered by water.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “四分之三”= three-fourths；分数作主语时谓语与 of 后的名词一致，surface 是单数，用 is covered。

q61.sampleAnswer: A stiff knee following surgery forced her to walk with a limp.
references: A stiff knee following surgery forced her to walk with a limp.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: 以“手术后僵直的膝盖”作主语，force sb. to do sth.“迫使某人做某事”；walk with a limp“跛行”。

q62.sampleAnswer: She liked to sunbathe in the seclusion of her own garden.
references: She liked to sunbathe in the seclusion of her own garden.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: like to do sth.；sunbathe 是不及物动词；“僻静”= in the seclusion of。

q63.sampleAnswer: They supply us with latest equipment regularly.
references: They supply us with latest equipment regularly.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: supply sb. with sth.“向某人提供某物”；regularly“定期地”。

q64.sampleAnswer: He did a part-time job so that he could support his family.
references: He did a part-time job so that he could support his family.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: so that 引导目的状语从句；support one’s family“养家”。

q65.sampleAnswer: Sometimes I surf the Internet and download e-books to read.
references: Sometimes I surf the Internet and download e-books to read.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “上网”= surf the Internet，与 download 并列，都用一般现在时。

q66.sampleAnswer: Suppose we can’t get the necessary equipment, what should we do?
references: Suppose we can’t get the necessary equipment, what should we do?

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: suppose 放句首作连词，意为“假设”，相当于 if。

q67.sampleAnswer: Not until the mother made sure that her son had got home safe and sound did she feel relieved.
references: Not until the mother made sure that her son had got home safe and sound did she feel relieved.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “直到……才”= Not until ...，放句首时主句部分倒装 did she feel；make sure“确信”。

q68.sampleAnswer: If a child depends on his parents for everything, his parents are responsible for it, because even animals know that they should teach their children how to survive.
references: If a child depends on his parents for everything, his parents are responsible for it, because even animals know that they should teach their children how to survive.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: depend on sb. for sth.“在某事上依赖某人”；how to survive“如何生存”，survive 作不及物动词。
